Sombria.Label: Sombria — Blood and Ember
Sombria.Description: Gothic and infernal, in shades of purple. A fragment of Tenebra's domain.

Countdowns.Title: Hourglasses
Countdowns.Empty: No hourglasses. Create one or add a floor countdown.
Countdowns.LoopHint: The countdown loops: flip the hourglass.

Inventario.Name: Sphere Pressure — Inventory
Inventario.Effect: An object in the scene reveals itself as a tier 1 mimic and uses Ambush on the nearest PC (spotlight without Fear). At most 2 per scene.

EcoDaLembranca.Name: Sphere Pressure — Echo of Memory
EcoDaLembranca.Effect: The PC with the most Hope makes a Presence reaction roll (14). Failure: loses 1 Hope and the GM gains 1 Fear. Success: sees a vision of one of the Demiurge's memories.

OlharDoVazio.Name: Sphere Pressure — Gaze of the Void
OlharDoVazio.Effect: Every PC far from any Void spawn makes an Instinct reaction roll (14) or becomes Terrified until spotlighted.

JogosMortais.Name: Deadly Games
JogosMortais.Effect: Ticks on each challenge cleared. When it runs out, the Dungeon Master leaves satisfied and hands over the reward and the sigil.

BrincarComAsVitimas.Name: Toying with the Victims
BrincarComAsVitimas.Effect: The Mystic Tyrant unleashes the Disintegration Ray (1 Fear): the target hit makes a death move.

Sussurro.Name: Sphere Pressure — Whisper
Sussurro.Effect: The PC with the most Hope makes a Knowledge reaction roll (14). Failure: gains 1 Transformation Token (cleared on a long rest).

AbolethEspreita.Name: The Aboleth Lurks
AbolethEspreita.Effect: The Aboleth uses Tentacle of the Deep: Agility reaction roll; failure = 2d10+6 physical damage and Restrained.

ShowVitals.Name: Vitals panel
ShowVitals.Hint: The GM sees the Vigil panel: the Fear counter and each character's hit points, armor, hope and stress, in real time. Players see only the Fear counter. Available in themes that include the panel.

ShowCountdowns.Name: Hourglasses
ShowCountdowns.Hint: Window with the adventure's countdowns drawn as hourglasses. The GM creates and ticks them; players only see the ones marked visible. Available in themes that include the window.

DefaultTheme.Name: World theme
DefaultTheme.Hint: Theme used by every player who has not picked another one.

Theme.Name: My theme
Theme.Hint: Theme used in this browser only. Follows the world theme by default.

Accent.Name: Accent color
Accent.Hint: Changes the theme's accent color for you only. Leave empty to use the theme's color.

ReduceEffects.Name: Reduce effects
ReduceEffects.Hint: Removes the glow and the cut corners. Useful on slower computers.

Variant.Name: Sphere floor
Variant.Hint: Visual variant of the Sombria theme for every player: each floor of the Sphere of Mysteries has its own palette, corners, texture and titles. A scene can set its own floor in the scene configuration.

SceneVariant.Name: Sphere floor (theme)
SceneVariant.Hint: While this scene is being viewed, the interface uses this floor of the Sombria theme. "Follow the world floor" uses the floor chosen in the module settings.

AnnounceVariant.Name: Announce floor changes
AnnounceVariant.Hint: Shows a card with the floor name when the GM changes floor or when the scene switches to a different floor.

Corte.Label: Floor 7 — The Court of Endless Night
Corte.Title: The Court of Endless Night
Corte.Subtitle: Hunger

Tribunal.Label: Floor 11 — The Tribunal of the Furies
Tribunal.Title: The Tribunal of the Furies
Tribunal.Subtitle: Guilt

Sigils.Title: Sigil Sockets
Sigils.EmptyHint: Empty socket. Drag a rune here or click to choose one.
Sigils.Unreached: A socket for a floor you have not reached yet.
Sigils.Hint: Drag a rune from an inventory onto a socket, or click an empty socket. Hover a socket to see which floor it belongs to.
Sigils.RevealHint: The party realises what lies behind the sockets. Everyone sees the reveal.
Sigils.VeilHint: Hide what lies behind the sockets again.
Sigils.ShowAllHint: Opens this screen for every connected player.
Sigils.RemoveConfirm: Remove {name} from floor {floor}? It goes back to {target}.
Sigils.RemoveConfirmKeep: Remove {name} from floor {floor}? The item stays where it was.
Sigils.PickHint: Choose the rune for the floor {floor} socket.
Sigils.NoRunes: None of your characters carries a rune.

Problem.Occupied: That socket already holds a rune.
Problem.NotRune: Only Sigil Generator runes fit the sockets.
Problem.NotOwner: You can only socket runes from your own characters' inventories.
Problem.AlreadyPlaced: That rune is already socketed on floor {floor}.
Problem.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to socket the rune.
Problem.NoJournal: This rune's journal was not found.
Problem.NoPermission: You do not have permission to see this rune's journal.

Dock.Hint: click to open; drag to move or pin to a corner
